items.hook: The Calhoun School is a progressive, co-educational, independent school on New York City's Upper West Side, serving students from Pre-K through 12th grade.
items.body: Founded in 1896, the school currently has approximately 600 students, housed in two separate buildings. One of those things you can't un-know.
